# Lib.volume.io

## Operators

- [**LoadNanoVdb**](LoadNanoVdb.md) — Loads a NanoVDB .nvdb file and uploads it as a GPU buffer.
- [**LoadVdb**](LoadVdb.md) — Loads grids from an OpenVDB file.
- [**SaveNanoVdb**](SaveNanoVdb.md) — Writes the volume as a NanoVDB file.
- [**SaveVdb**](SaveVdb.md) — Writes the volume's grids to an OpenVDB file.
